div.head: Leis Wl 3.4
div.ab: E s’il pot dedenz un an e un jur truver le larrun e amener a justise, si lui rendra cil les XX sol., kis averad oud, si n’ert feite la justise del larrun.
E s’il pot dedenz un an e [un] jur trover le larun e amener a la justice, si li rendra les vint solz kis avrad out, e si’n ert faite la justice de larun.
Quodsi infra annum et diem poterit latronem repertum iusticie offerre, reddetur ei libra, quam pro capite calumpnians accepit; et de latrone iusticia fiat.
E s'il pot, dedenz un an e un jur, truver le larrun e amener a justise, si lui rendra cil les XX sol., kis averad oud, e si'n ert feite la justise del larrun.

3, 4. Und wenn der [Bürge] binnen 1 Jahr und 1 Tag den Dieb finden und vor Gericht führen kann, so soll ihm die 20 Schilling zurückgeben der [Kläger], welcher sie [als Busse] erhalten hat, und es soll die Gerechtigkeit [Leibesstrafe] an dem Diebe vollstreckt werden (IL).

3, 4. And if the [surety] can find the thief within 1 year and 1 day and lead him before the court, then the [plaintiff] who has received them [as compensation] shall give him back the 20 shillings, and justice [corporal punishment] shall be executed on the thief (IL).

And if he can find the thief within a year and a day and bring him to Court, the plaintiff shall restore to him the 20 shillings which he received (as compensation), and justice shall be executed upon the thief.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 254–255 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 496–497, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
